title: 第1450章 竟然英年早婚孩子都这么第1449章 我打下来的江山
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 小器灵眼底掩藏毁天灭地杀意！
没有人能伤害她的主人！
没有人！
“主人，已经找到她们藏身之所了，我要杀了她们！”
“这一次，她们再也不能逃！”
接着，小器灵伸手，蓦地她体内迸发出巨大火光。
火光形成巨龙，在山洞崖底盘旋，以风驰电掣之势，迅速冲向高阶系统的私人领域。
砰！
巨大火光在山洞内爆开！
无数火光纷纷落下，而被冲击的私域，仿佛只是一个屏障，一道障眼法，被巨龙冲散后形成碎片落在地上。
叶苜苜看着幕布里的一切，“假的，竟然是假的！”
“欺骗小器灵的障眼法！”
战承胤眉峰皱起，他说：“这些高价系统全数尽出，不惜暗杀神明，怕是想引诱小器灵到山洞崖底……”
“糟糕，小家伙跑，快跑……”
战承胤话音一落，果然，山洞另一处传来毁灭性的爆炸声。
埋下十吨炸药在洞内爆炸。
洞内山体尽毁，无数山石碎成粉末，呈圆圈往四面八方地炸开。
因为爆炸距离和齐国都城，领主基地不过几百里的距离。
就连这边都能感受到明显震感。
放置在天台上的太空舱，玻璃瞬间碎裂了好几片。
城内的百姓，尤其是住在高楼上，大楼摇晃感觉很明显。
砰……方圆十里大山被炸药炸成粉末，而小器灵在爆炸前几秒就已经闪现回到空间，回到叶苜苜身边。
她很生气，双眼气红，脸颊气的鼓鼓的。
“该死的！”
“居然做局欺骗我，我真的感受到了伤害主人的人踪迹！”
“我以为找到他们，没想到他们伤害主人是演戏，真正的目的是想要杀我！”
“小看我了，真以为我是这么好杀的！”
“主神系统都拿我没办法，天真！”
叶苜苜把她抱在怀里，查看她有没有受伤。
还好，小家伙除了落下山洞时，身上蹭到山洞石壁灰尘，有些脏，其他的没有受伤。
她反映迅速之余，也布置了结界，把爆炸源镇压在山洞崖底，才没有波及她。
小家伙还是很生气，咬牙切齿道：“他们一定还在这个位面，没有跑！”
“我就算掘地三尺，也要把他们挖出来！”
“气死我了！”
叶苜苜安慰小家。
“好了，好了，别生气了！”
“等会儿，我带你去现代吃蛋糕，怎么样？”
“软软甜丝丝的慕斯蛋糕，各种口味的水果蛋糕，想不想吃？”
小家伙一提到吃的，愤怒的表情终于散去，她张开嘴巴，好似有口水流出来。
小手赶紧捂住。
小家伙脾气来得快，去得也快……抬头乌黑眼珠带着期待，软萌萌的声音问叶苜苜：“主人是真的吗？”
“真的可以吃很多很多蛋糕？”
content_en:
,,!
Xiao Qi Ling's eyes hide the murderous intention to destroy the world!
No one can harm her master!
No one!
"Master, we have found their hiding place, I want to kill them!"
"This time, they can't escape again!"
Then, the little weapon spirit stretched out her hand, and suddenly a huge fire burst out from her body.
The fire formed a giant dragon, swirling on the bottom of the cave cliff, and quickly rushed towards the private domain of the high-level system with lightning speed.
Bang!
Huge fire exploded in the cave!
Countless firelights fell one after another, and the private domain that was impacted seemed to be just a barrier, a blindfold, scattered by the giant dragon and fell into fragments on the ground.
Ye Clover looked at everything behind the curtain, "It's fake, it's actually fake!"
"A trick to deceive the little weapon spirit!"
Zhan Chengyin frowned and said: "All these high-priced systems are available, and they are not willing to assassinate the gods. I am afraid that they want to lure the little weapon spirits to the bottom of the cave cliff..."
"Oops, little guy, run, run quickly..."
As soon as Zhan Chengyin finished speaking, sure enough, a devastating explosion sounded from another part of the cave.
Ten tons of explosives were buried and exploded in the cave.
The mountain inside the cave was completely destroyed, and countless rocks were broken into powder and exploded in all directions in a circle.
Because the explosion was only a few hundred miles away from the Qi capital and the lord base.
A clear tremor can be felt even here.
Several pieces of glass were instantly shattered in the space capsule placed on the rooftop.
People in the city, especially those who live in high-rise buildings, feel the building shaking obviously.
Bang... The mountains within a radius of ten miles were blown into powder by explosives, and the small weapon spirit had already flashed back to space and returned to Ye Clover a few seconds before the explosion.
She was very angry, her eyes were red and her cheeks were bulging with anger.
"Damn it!"
"You actually deceived me. I really felt the traces of the person who hurt the master!"
"I thought I found them, but I didn't expect that they hurt the master for an act. Their real purpose was to kill me!"
"You underestimated me, you really thought I was so easy to kill!"
"The main god system can't do anything to me, naive!"
Ye Clover held her in his arms and checked if she was injured.
Fortunately, the little guy was not injured except for the dust on the cave wall when he fell into the cave.
After reacting quickly, she also set up a barrier to suppress the source of the explosion at the bottom of the cave cliff, so that it did not affect her.
The little guy was still very angry and gritted his teeth and said: "They must still be in this plane and not run away!"
"I will dig them out even if I dig three feet into the ground!"
"I'm so angry!"
Ye Clover comforted Xiaojia.
"Okay, okay, don't be angry!"
"Wait a minute, how about I take you to modern times to eat cake?"
"Soft and sweet mousse cake, fruit cakes of various flavors, do you want to eat them?"
When the little guy mentioned food, her angry expression finally dissipated. She opened her mouth and saliva seemed to flow out.
He quickly covered it with his little hands.
The little guy's temper comes and goes quickly... He raised his head with dark eyes full of expectation, and asked Ye Clover in a soft and cute voice: "Is the master real?"
"Can you really eat a lot of cake?"
